thesis: The page is the sticker on the glass, peeled back: every number on an impact window's label lifts at the corner to show what it means for your Naples house, and nothing is sold until it has been read.

signature.name: Peel-Back Label
signature.summary: A white sticker with a lifted dog-ear corner whose underside is yellow; scroll or tap curls the corner further and uncovers the plain-English meaning printed underneath the number. Shows as the hero mask, explainer rows, price tags, review stickers, order-by sticker and a peeled sticker left on the footer.

palette.family: Lanai Night + Sticker White + Label Yellow + Gulf Blue

layoutMoves: editorial cover: the masthead is the label, cover lines (DP, missile, U-factor, SHGC, order-by) are real anchors, the lanai photo sits under a curled-corner sticker
label explainer as one huge sticker spanning 8 of 12 columns with rows that peel, plain words in the right margin
order-by timeline as a full-width 12-month calendar bar with hurricane season shaded as a band, not a storm

motion.intro: The hero label corner curls from flat to 14% in 900ms while the first label row's value types in; skippable, text readable from frame 0.
stories: peel: each label row's corner lifts with --sw-p as it crosses mid-viewport, uncovering its meaning
dial/stack: order-by months fill left to right to June 1 as you scroll the timeline
motion.hover: the sticker corner lifts 6px (curl grows) on hover/focus of any label-styled card or button
